steps.text: Place mixed berries, banana, strawberry yogurt, milk, and sugar in a blender; cover and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses; serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Berry Delicious
raw_recipe.description: This berry delicious smoothie recipe includes frozen berries, strawberry yogurt, and a whole banana puréed in a blender for a delicious, drinkable treat.
raw_recipe.name: Berry Delicious

recipeInstructions.text: Place mixed berries, banana, strawberry yogurt, milk, and sugar in a blender; cover and blend until smooth. Pour into glasses; serve.

review.reviewBody: Very good. I used a combination of frozen berries(cranberries, blackberries and strawberries) and used low-fat vanilla yogurt. My kids gulped this down.

The first time I made this I was ready to give it a 3, but that was mostly because it had too strong a banana flavor which I do not like - I want the banana more subtle. But, I had used an over-ripe banana and had left out the sugar, and thought it only fair to make it again. So I used a less ripe banana and did add the sugar, which unlike many people, I did think was necessary. (And I'm no sugar fanatic by any means. I think it had more to do with flavor than sweetening.) I'm sure it depends on the selected berries somewhat, and how good the fruit is. I used blueberries, strawberries, blackberries and raspberries. (Less strawberries the second time because I also like the strawberry flavor more subtle.) I don't like the seeds of black/raspberries, so I've started straining them. This can be quite thick and the only good way to strain them is put them and all the milk only in the blender, strain, and then add everything else.

I'm so grateful to the original poster for putting this recipe up! I have struggled to make a good smoothie for far too long, and this one is perfect. Just the right amount of sweetness and a good consistency. I did substitute and put my own little twist on it. I used Greek vanilla yogurt, unsweetened almond milk, and a frozen berry blend that included cherries, strawberries, and raspberries. I added about a teaspoon of honey, although I don't think I would have missed it if I didn't. I also used a scoop of Green Superfood mix. My biggest takeaway is to use the same amount of liquid as frozen ingredients. It makes it the right consistency. Now I feel brave enough to experiment with other smoothies since I've got one great one under my belt!

I've made a few changes to this recipe. I've used 1/2 cup apple juice, 1 cup milk, 1 cup plain or vanilla yogurt, and 2 cup frozen mixed berries. No sugar needed. Try this, it's delicious and filling. Makes about 2 servings.

What a perfect, healthy, refreshing snack. Very thick too! Some changes I made:
1) Halved the recipe (it was just for me)
2) Substituted plain yogurt with no added sugar for the strawberry yogurt
3) Substituted 2 packets Splenda for the sugar.

If I could have found no sugar added strawberry yogurt I would have used that, but I could only find plain. It still tasted wonderful!

A very simple and good recipes for breakfast. For a healthier smoothie, i used almond milk instead of regular milk, greek yogurt , and added a spoon of rolled oats and chia seeds. I changed the measurements to suit one serving and added 1/4 cup of water as i thought it was not enough liquids but it did give it a watery taste at the end. Next time i will probably try it with ice instead.

Berry good! I used a mix of frozen strawberries and blueberries. I also froze my banana. I didn't have strawberry yogurt, so I subbed non-fat vanilla yogurt and instead of the sugar added a bit of low sugar strawberry preserves. What a thick, frosty treat that's really good and good for you too!

We've made this a few times now and the kids love it! They beg for this for dessert. The first time we used frozen strawberries and two bananas (no sugar). Tonight we used frozen raspberries, one banana, and vanilla yogurt (we were out of strawberry), and again no sugar. I'm not a big fan of smoothies myself, but I love that the kids are raving over this healthy dessert!

I generally include 2 or 3 bananas and substituted almond milk for dairy milk. I am not a fan of almond milk for drinking or on cereal but it is good for baking and cooking. I sometimes drink it for breakfast and sometimes as a desert. I prefer water during the day.

I've tried a recipe similar to this and it's awesome. Yeah, it has a lot of seeds, but what do you expect, especially if you use stuff like strawberries and raspberries? Personally,I love it with the seeds! Reduce the milk by half and add 1/4c. of apple juice. Gives it a bit of an extra sweet kick! Yummy!
This is a delicious, creamy, not too thick glass of goodness! I did not add the sugar, but did add in 1-1/2-tbsp of pumpkin seed protein powder. Thank you for sharing.
I liked it a lot :)
Delicious! I love this recipe and will use it much more! I think it tastes better without the sugar but either way it is great.
no but i love it and i have made every moring
This might be one of the best smoothies ever. I recommend strongly. The Smoothie is also a big hit for kids. They love it! Definitely will make again! Yum!
Me personally did not make any changes and yes i would make it again anyday

I made this and other than using vanilla yogurt I made the rest of the recipe as it calls for. I have to say that it was good enough that my youngest daughter and me drank almost the entire thing as soon as it was made.
Loved it very good and you can just mix and match with it!
Berry Delicious??? More like berry disgusting!! Frozen mixed berries what were you thinking?! I'm berry upset with the final result... it's unbearable!
It is delicious. You can add protein powder to it and eliminate a meal.
